# AU-BizIntel MCP Server

**Australian Business Intelligence for AI Agents**

Built by [LJ Digital](https://ljdigital.com.au) — connecting AI agents to real Australian business data.

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D18-green.svg)](https://nodejs.org)
[![MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-compatible-purple.svg)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io)

## What It Does

Gives any MCP-compatible AI agent (Claude, Cursor, Kilo Code, etc.) instant access to the Australian Business Register (ABR) — plus AI-powered business intelligence. Search 8M+ registered Australian entities by name or ABN, get full profiles, check GST status, and get an AI-generated opportunity assessment for any business.

**Try the web version:** [bizintel.ljdigital.com.au](https://bizintel.ljdigital.com.au)

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `abn_lookup` | Look up any ABN → entity name, type, GST status, location |
| `acn_lookup` | Look up a company by ACN (Australian Company Number) |
| `search_business` | Search entities by name (with optional state filter) |
| `check_gst_status` | Check if an ABN is currently GST registered |
| `get_entity_details` | Full entity profile as structured JSON |
| `research_prospect` | **AI-powered** — full intelligence profile + opportunity assessment (High/Medium/Low score, signals, and specific AI proposition for that business type) |

## Quick Start

### Prerequisites
- Node.js 18+
- Free ABR API GUID — register at [abr.business.gov.au/Tools/WebServices](https://abr.business.gov.au/Tools/WebServices)
- Anthropic API key (for `research_prospect` tool only — other tools work without it)

### Installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ljdigital/au-bizintel-mcp.git
cd au-bizintel-mcp
npm install
```

### Configuration

Create a `.env` file:
```
ABR_GUID=your-abr-guid-here
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your-anthropic-key-here  # optional, needed for research_prospect
```

### Claude Desktop Config

Add to your `claude_desktop_config.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "au-bizintel": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/path/to/au-bizintel-mcp/src/server.js"],
      "env": {
        "ABR_GUID": "your-guid-here",
        "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "your-key-here"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Example Usage

Once connected, ask your AI agent:

- *"Look up ABN 33 051 775 556"*
- *"Is Atlassian GST registered?"*
- *"Search for accounting firms in NSW"*
- *"Research Telstra as a prospect"*
- *"Get the full entity profile for BHP"*

## Data Source

All data sourced from the [Australian Business Register (ABR)](https://abr.business.gov.au) — official Australian Government data, updated in real time. AI assessments generated by Claude (Anthropic).

## Getting Your ABR GUID

1. Go to [abr.business.gov.au/Tools/WebServices](https://abr.business.gov.au/Tools/WebServices)
2. Click "Register" and fill in the form
3. Your GUID is emailed immediately — it's free
